views.title: Korean T9 search for the Phone app

views.markdown: Search contacts by Korean initial consonants directly from the Phone keypad. T9Dialer 2.3.0 rebuilds the original tweak from reverse-engineered behavior, restores broken features, and adds iOS 18 support and configurable speed dial.

- Korean and English T9 search modes
- Inline swipe or result-sheet UI
- Optional phone-number search and key haptics
- Speed dial on keys 2–9
- Toggleable TelephonyUI-9/10 Korean keypad images
- Highlight color and family-name-first display options
- Required color-picker dependency bundled in one package

views.title: iOS 26
views.text: Installs, but runtime behavior is untested

views.markdown:
### 2.3.0

- Reimplemented the original search and result UI from reverse-engineered behavior.
- Fixed preference persistence, phone-number search, haptics, and highlight colors.
- Added iOS 18 search support and speed dial.
- Integrated Korean keypad images and required dependencies.
- Added a reversible Korean keypad toggle.
